section_1_cloze.passage:
I had just finished walking my dog as it got dark. We headed home and walked into the [41] . A flicker (闪烁) of light caught my eye just as I [42] the door. I turned my head to see that a [43] firefly had flown in with us through the open [44] and was now crazily trying to [45] . As it flew slowly towards the wall, I quickly but [46] closed my fingers around it. I could feel its little wings beat against my [47] and a flash of light shown through my fingers. I opened the back door and [48] outside. Then I opened my hand and watched it fly away flashing its light in the [49] .
Before I walked back in, I took the [50] to look over the grassland behind my home. There were hundreds of fireflies flickering. Each time their lights came on, I smiled. It was so amazing that such little creatures could [51] so much light. I stood there in awe.
[52] the lightening fireflies made me think of the light each of us [53] inside of ourselves. Often it flickers and is not steady or even very bright. Yet, every time we shine it, we grow a little brighter. And every time we [54] the light, we can [55] the light in others to shine as well.
Do your best to shine your light even if you think it is a mere flicker. You are a lot brighter than you think.

questions.explanation: 根据上文的“We headed home”可知，作者和狗正朝家走去，因此接下来是走进了“房子（house）”。易错点：可能受下文grassland干扰，但此时刚到家，且后文提到有门（door），应是室内。
questions.supplement:
A(forest)：语境句：The children got lost in the dense forest. 固定搭配：dense forest, pine forest
B(house)：语境句：They recently moved into a new house in the suburbs. 固定搭配：move house, keep house
C(grassland)：语境句：Sheep are grazing peacefully on the vast grassland. 固定搭配：vast grassland, natural grassland
D(garden)：语境句：She spends her weekends planting flowers in the garden. 固定搭配：botanical garden, garden tools

questions.explanation: 根据下文的“flown in with us through the open [44(door)]”可知，萤火虫是趁门开着飞进来的。此刻作者刚好到家，自然是顺手“关（closed）”门时注意到了闪烁的光。
questions.supplement:
A(kicked)：语境句：The boy kicked the ball into the net. 固定搭配：kick the habit, kick off
B(repaired)：语境句：My car broke down and needs to be repaired. 固定搭配：repair a car, beyond repair
C(touched)：语境句：I was deeply touched by her inspiring speech. 固定搭配：keep in touch, touch on
D(closed)：语境句：Please ensure the door is closed before you leave. 固定搭配：close the door, close to

questions.explanation: 修饰萤火虫（firefly），且后文第二段称其为“such little creatures”，因此此处选“极小的（tiny）”符合萤火虫的体型特征。
questions.supplement:
A(blind)：语境句：The accident left him blind in the right eye. 固定搭配：turn a blind eye to, blind date
B(familiar)：语境句：Her face seemed familiar, but I couldn't remember her name. 固定搭配：be familiar with, look familiar
C(tiny)：语境句：The baby grabbed my finger with his tiny hand. 固定搭配：tiny amount, tiny detail
D(dangerous)：语境句：It is dangerous to walk alone in the dark alley. 固定搭配：highly dangerous, dangerous goods

questions.explanation: 萤火虫是跟着作者一起从敞开的“门（door）”飞进来的，呼应第42题的“door”。
questions.supplement:
A(cage)：语境句：The bird escaped from its cage and flew away. 固定搭配：bird cage, golden cage
B(hand)：语境句：He held the fragile glass carefully in his hand. 固定搭配：give a hand, hand in hand
C(door)：语境句：Someone is knocking at the front door. 固定搭配：open the door, next door
D(sky)：语境句：The sky suddenly turned dark before the storm. 固定搭配：blue sky, night sky

questions.explanation: 萤火虫飞进了屋子被困住，因此现在正发疯似地试图“出去（get out）”。
questions.supplement:
A(get out)：语境句：The trapped animal tried desperately to get out. 固定搭配：get out of, word gets out
B(fight back)：语境句：When faced with unfair treatment, we must fight back. 固定搭配：fight back tears, fight back against
C(speed up)：语境句：We need to speed up the process to meet the deadline. 固定搭配：speed up production, speed up economic growth
D(stay on)：语境句：He decided to stay on for another year at the university. 固定搭配：stay on track, stay on top of

questions.explanation: 由于萤火虫很小很脆弱，作者虽然动作快（quickly），但必须“轻轻地（gently）”握住它，以免伤害它。but表转折，暗示动作轻柔。
questions.supplement:
A(gently)：语境句：The mother gently patted her baby to sleep. 固定搭配：smile gently, touch gently
B(warmly)：语境句：The foreign guests were warmly welcomed by the local people. 固定搭配：welcome warmly, speak warmly of
C(similarly)：语境句：Men and women should be treated similarly in the workplace. 固定搭配：behave similarly, dress similarly
D(regularly)：语境句：It is important to exercise regularly to stay healthy. 固定搭配：update regularly, check regularly

questions.explanation: 作者用手指将萤火虫合拢握住，因此萤火虫的翅膀是拍打在作者的手部“皮肤（skin）”上。
questions.supplement:
A(head)：语境句：He shook his head in disappointment. 固定搭配：keep one's head, head over heels
B(heart)：语境句：Her words touched the bottom of my heart. 固定搭配：learn by heart, break one's heart
C(skin)：语境句：Too much sun exposure can damage your skin. 固定搭配：sensitive skin, skin care
D(eye)：语境句：She kept a close eye on the children playing in the park. 固定搭配：catch one's eye, keep an eye on

questions.explanation: 作者打开后门，“迈步（stepped）”走到了外面，准备把萤火虫放走。step outside意为走到门外。
questions.supplement:
A(escaped)：语境句：The thief escaped from the prison last night. 固定搭配：narrow escape, escape from
B(stepped)：语境句：She stepped forward to accept the award. 固定搭配：step outside, step forward, step by step
C(survived)：语境句：Only a few passengers survived the plane crash. 固定搭配：survive on, survive from
D(waited)：语境句：We waited patiently for the train to arrive. 固定搭配：wait for, wait in line

questions.explanation: 呼应文章第一句的“got dark”，此时外面已经天黑，所以萤火虫是在“黑暗（darkness）”中闪烁着光芒飞走。
questions.supplement:
A(trees)：语境句：The birds are singing merrily in the trees. 固定搭配：plant trees, fruit trees
B(noise)：语境句：The loud noise kept me awake all night. 固定搭配：make a noise, background noise
C(crowds)：语境句：He pushed his way through the thick crowds. 固定搭配：attract crowds, in crowds
D(darkness)：语境句：The power went out, leaving the room in total darkness. 固定搭配：total darkness, in the darkness

questions.explanation: take the time to do sth 是固定搭配，意为“花时间做某事/抽出时间做某事”。作者在进屋前，特意花时间看了看屋后的草地。
questions.supplement:
A(wish)：语境句：She made a wish before blowing out the candles. 固定搭配：make a wish, best wishes
B(plan)：语境句：Do you have any plan for the upcoming holiday? 固定搭配：make a plan, carry out a plan
C(time)：语境句：You should take the time to read the instructions carefully. 固定搭配：take the time to do, kill time, in time
D(promise)：语境句：He broke his promise and didn't show up. 固定搭配：make a promise, keep a promise

questions.explanation: 萤火虫靠自身发光，因此是“产生（produce）”光芒。reflect（反射）、absorb（吸收）不符合萤火虫发光的科学常识。
questions.supplement:
A(reflect)：语境句：The calm water reflects the beautiful sunset. 固定搭配：reflect on, reflect light
B(produce)：语境句：The factory produces high-quality cars. 固定搭配：produce light, mass produce
C(stand)：语境句：I can't stand the terrible weather here. 固定搭配：stand for, stand out
D(absorb)：语境句：Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air. 固定搭配：absorb heat, be absorbed in

questions.explanation: 结合上一段的“watched it fly away”和“I stood there in awe”可知，作者一直站在那里“观看（Watching）”萤火虫，由此引发了感悟。
questions.supplement:
A(Watching)：语境句：Watching English movies is a good way to improve listening skills. 固定搭配：watch out, watch over
B(Catching)：语境句：Catching a bad cold made him miss the final exam. 固定搭配：catch a cold, catch sight of
C(Guiding)：语境句：Guiding the blind man across the street made her feel proud. 固定搭配：guide dog, tour guide
D(Rescuing)：语境句：The firefighters succeeded in rescuing the boy from the fire. 固定搭配：rescue from, come to one's rescue

questions.explanation: 作者将萤火虫的光比作人们内心“携带（carries）”的光芒。carry inside of ourselves 意为存在于我们内心的（特质、光芒等）。
questions.supplement:
A(misses)：语境句：He misses his hometown terribly when studying abroad. 固定搭配：miss the bus, miss the opportunity
B(receives)：语境句：She receives lots of gifts on her birthday. 固定搭配：receive an education, receive a letter
C(blocks)：语境句：The fallen tree blocks the road entirely. 固定搭配：block the way, block out
D(carries)：语境句：He carries a heavy burden of responsibility. 固定搭配：carry on, carry out, carry weight

questions.explanation: 根据后半句“we can [55] the light in others to shine as well”可知，当我们“分享（share）”自己的光时，也能让别人的光亮起来。
questions.supplement:
A(hide)：语境句：She tried to hide her sadness behind a fake smile. 固定搭配：hide from, hide away
B(share)：语境句：It is a virtue to share what you have with others. 固定搭配：share with, share an interest
C(avoid)：语境句：He took a different route to avoid the heavy traffic. 固定搭配：avoid doing sth, avoid conflicts
D(understand)：语境句：It is difficult to understand his complex theory. 固定搭配：make oneself understood, fully understand

questions.explanation: 分享自己的光可以“唤醒（awaken）”他人心中的光芒。follow（跟随）、request（请求）、permit（允许）均不如awaken契合此处传递能量、点燃希望的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(awaken)：语境句：The documentary helped awaken the public to the danger of climate change. 固定搭配：awaken sb to sth, awaken from
B(follow)：语境句：Please follow the instructions on the package carefully. 固定搭配：follow the rules, follow one's heart
C(request)：语境句：The guests request that their room be cleaned daily. 固定搭配：request sb to do sth, make a request
D(permit)：语境句：Smoking is not permitted in this building. 固定搭配：permit doing sth, permit sb to do sth

vocab_pack.definition_en: to attract someone's attention
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 'caught my eye' 是过去时，主语 a flicker of light，catch 的过去式 caught，表示「引起了我的注意」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bright colors of the poster always catch my eye.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 海报明亮的颜色总是吸引我的注意。
vocab_pack.from_passage: A flicker of light caught my eye

vocab_pack.definition_en: a brief, unsteady light
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'A flicker of light' 中 flicker 是名词，作主语，后接 of light 为后置定语，表示「一束闪烁的光」。
vocab_pack.example_en: There was a flicker of hope in her eyes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她眼中闪过一丝希望。
vocab_pack.from_passage: A flicker of light caught my eye

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a frantic, uncontrolled manner
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 'crazily trying' 中 crazily 是副词，修饰动词 trying，表示「疯狂地试图」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The fans crazily cheered for their team.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 球迷们疯狂地为他们的队伍欢呼。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was now crazily trying to get out

vocab_pack.definition_en: to leave or escape from a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'trying to get out' 中 get out 是不定式短语，作宾语，表示「出去」的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bird managed to get out of the cage.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那只鸟设法逃出了笼子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to get out

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a soft, careful manner
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'gently closed' 中 gently 是副词，修饰动词 closed，表示「温柔地合拢」。
vocab_pack.example_en: She gently placed the baby in the crib.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她轻轻地把婴儿放在婴儿床里。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I quickly but gently closed my fingers around it

vocab_pack.definition_en: to bring one's fingers together to hold something gently
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'closed my fingers around it' 是过去时，closed 是 close 的过去式，表示「合拢手指握住它」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He closed his fingers around the coin and smiled.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他合拢手指握住硬币，笑了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I quickly but gently closed my fingers around it

vocab_pack.definition_en: to strike or flap repeatedly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'beat against my skin' 是动词原形，在 feel sth do 结构中作宾语补足语（不带 to 的不定式），表示「感觉到翅膀拍打皮肤」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bird beat its wings rapidly to take off.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那只鸟快速拍动翅膀起飞。
vocab_pack.from_passage: its little wings beat against my skin

vocab_pack.definition_en: a sudden brief burst of light
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'a flash of light' 中 flash 是名词，作主语，表示「一道闪光」。
vocab_pack.example_en: A flash of lightning illuminated the sky.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一道闪电照亮了天空。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a flash of light shown through my fingers

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go outside (literally by stepping out)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'stepped outside' 是过去时，stepped 是 step 的过去式，表示「走到外面」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Let's step outside for some fresh air.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们出去透透气吧。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I opened the back door and stepped outside.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to leave by flying
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'watch it fly away' 中 fly away 是省略 to 的不定式，在 watch it 后作宾语补足语，表示「看着它飞走」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The butterfly will fly away if you get too close.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果你靠得太近，蝴蝶会飞走。
vocab_pack.from_passage: watched it fly away flashing its light in the darkness

vocab_pack.definition_en: to emit a sudden brief light
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'flashing its light' 是现在分词短语作伴随状语，表示「闪烁着它的光」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The camera flashed as he took the picture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他拍照时相机闪光了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: flashing its light in the darkness

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make an effort to do something even though one may be busy
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'took the time to look over' 中 took 是 take 的过去式，表示「花了时间去查看」。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should take the time to review your answers before submitting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你应该花时间在提交前检查答案。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I took the time to look over the grassland behind my home.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to examine or survey quickly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'to look over the grassland' 是不定式短语，look over 表示「审视、查看」草地。
vocab_pack.example_en: I need to look over the document before signing it.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 签署文件前我需要检查一下。
vocab_pack.from_passage: look over the grassland behind my home

vocab_pack.definition_en: a large number of (used for emphasis)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'hundreds of fireflies' 中 hundreds of 是数量短语，修饰复数名词，表示「数百只萤火虫」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Hundreds of students attended the lecture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 数百名学生参加了讲座。
vocab_pack.from_passage: There were hundreds of fireflies flickering.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a flying insect that produces a flashing light
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'fireflies' 是复数形式，表示「萤火虫」，作主语。
vocab_pack.example_en: In summer, we can see fireflies glowing in the garden.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 夏天，我们能看到萤火虫在花园里发光。
vocab_pack.from_passage: hundreds of fireflies flickering

vocab_pack.definition_en: to shine with a wavering or unsteady light
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'fireflies flickering' 中 flickering 是现在分词作后置定语，相当于定语从句 that were flickering，表示「闪烁的萤火虫」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The candle flickered in the wind.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 蜡烛在风中闪烁。
vocab_pack.from_passage: hundreds of fireflies flickering

vocab_pack.definition_en: every time; whenever
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'Each time their lights came on' 中 each time 引导时间状语从句，表示「每次灯亮起时」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Each time she sees that movie, she cries.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每次看那部电影，她都会哭。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Each time their lights came on

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start to work or operate (especially lights, electricity)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'came on' 是过去时，come on 表示「（萤火虫的）光亮起」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The lights come on automatically at dusk.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 灯在黄昏时会自动亮起。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Each time their lights came on

vocab_pack.definition_en: causing great surprise or wonder
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'It was so amazing that...' 中 amazing 是形容词作表语，与 was 构成系表结构，表示「如此令人惊叹」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The view from the top of the mountain was amazing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 山顶的景色令人惊叹。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It was so amazing that such little creatures could produce so much light.

vocab_pack.definition_en: feeling respect and wonder, often mixed with fear
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'stood there in awe' 中 in awe 是介词短语作状语，修饰 stood，表示「敬畏地站立」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He stood in awe of the magnificent mountain.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他敬畏地站在宏伟的山峰前。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I stood there in awe.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become lighter or brighter; to give off light
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'the lightening fireflies' 中 lightening 是现在分词作定语，lighten 表示「（萤火虫）正在发光」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The sky began to lighten as dawn approached.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 黎明临近时，天空开始变亮。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Watching the lightening fireflies

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to have a particular thought or memory
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'made me think of' 是过去时，made 是 make 的过去式，后接宾语 me 和不定式短语 think of，表示「让我想起」。
vocab_pack.example_en: This music always makes me think of summer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这首音乐总是让我想起夏天。
vocab_pack.from_passage: made me think of the light each of us carries inside of ourselves

vocab_pack.definition_en: not changing; constant; firm
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'is not steady' 中 steady 是形容词作表语，与 is 构成系表结构，表示「不稳定」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Keep a steady hand when drawing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 画画时手要保持稳定。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Often it flickers and is not steady

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give out light; to be bright
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'shine it' 中 shine 是动词原形，主语 we，一般现在时，表示「我们发出光芒」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The sun shines brightly in the morning.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 早晨太阳明亮地照耀。
vocab_pack.from_passage: every time we shine it

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become increasingly bright
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'grow a little brighter' 中 grow 是系动词，后接比较级形容词 brighter，表示「变得明亮一些」。
vocab_pack.example_en: As the fire burned, the flames grew brighter.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 随着火燃烧，火焰变得更亮。
vocab_pack.from_passage: we grow a little brighter

vocab_pack.definition_en: to spread one's light, positivity, or kindness to others
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 分享光芒（喻指传递积极或善意）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'share the light' 是动词短词，一般现在时，主语 we，表示「我们分享光芒」。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should always share the light of kindness with others.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该始终与他人分享善良的光芒。
vocab_pack.from_passage: And every time we share the light

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause to become active, awake, or aware
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'awaken the light' 中 awaken 是动词原形，在情态动词 can 后，表示「能够唤醒光芒」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The loud noise awakened everyone in the house.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 巨大的噪音惊醒了屋子里的每个人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: we can awaken the light in others

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make the greatest possible effort
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'Do your best' 是祈使句，do 为原形，your 为所有格，表示「尽你所能」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Always do your best in everything you attempt.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 凡事尽你最大努力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Do your best to shine your light

vocab_pack.definition_en: small; only; just (used to emphasize how small something is)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'a mere flicker' 中 mere 是形容词，修饰 flicker，表示「仅仅是微光」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He was a mere child when he started playing piano.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他开始弹钢琴时仅仅是个孩子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: even if you think it is a mere flicker

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to introduce a condition that does not affect the truth of the main statement
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'even if you think' 中 even if 引导让步状语从句，表示「即使你认为」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Even if it rains, we will still go hiking.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 即使下雨，我们还是会去远足。
vocab_pack.from_passage: even if you think it is a mere flicker

section_2_word_form.passage:
French theater director Patrick Sommier, who is devoted to passing on the true meaning of Chinese operas, has made outstanding contributions to Sino-French cultural exchanges.
Recalling his first cooperation with the Chinese theater professors in 2004, he said he was touched by the actors' makeup, costumes and their effort [56] on the acting skills to their students. One professor explained, "In China, opera is an art [57] lifelong devotion and the effect of the performance largely depends on the actors' inner strength and acting skills."
Following Sommier's suggestion on introducing Chinese [58] to the French audience, Beijing Vocational College of Opera and Arts (BVCOA) [59] a series of appealing and [60] performances in 2005. The shows drew over 22,000 French students, half of [61] got involved in the workshops on Chinese opera makeup and gestures afterwards. Sommier always hopes the audience truly understand that theater is not a product to consume [62] a real cultural meeting and an approach toward what we wonder.
The year 2024 marks the [63] anniversary (周年纪念) of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and France. Serving as a cultural courier (信使), Sommier hopes the French and Chinese will impress each other [64] high-quality shows. His [65] to cultural exchanges is positive proof of the power of arts in bringing people together and fostering global harmony.

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。effort to do sth 是固定用法，意为“做某事的努力”，此处不定式作后置定语，修饰effort。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to pass)：语境句：He made every effort to pass the driving test. 固定搭配：make an effort to do sth, pass on to。原词pass其它变形：passing (adj./n.), passage (n.), passenger (n.)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。art 与 require 之间为主动关系，且句子已有谓语动词is，故使用现在分词 requiring 作后置定语，相当于定语从句 that requires...。
questions.supplement: 正确形(requiring)：语境句：Nursing is a demanding profession requiring much patience. 固定搭配：require doing sth / require to be done, require sb to do sth。原词require其它变形：required (adj.), requirement (n.)

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。classic 作名词时指“经典著作/作品”，为可数名词。泛指中国经典作品应使用复数形式 classics。
questions.supplement: 正确形(classics)：语境句：Reading literary classics helps broaden our horizons. 固定搭配：read classics, modern classics。原词classic其它变形：classical (adj. 古典的, 传统文化的)

questions.explanation: 考查动词时态。句中缺少谓语动词，且有明确的时间状语 in 2005，故使用一般过去时 staged，意为“上演，举办”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(staged)：语境句：The students staged a brilliant play at the arts festival. 固定搭配：stage a play, stage a protest。原词stage其它搭配：on stage, set the stage for

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。空处与形容词 appealing 并列，共同修饰名词 performances，故需将动词 innovate 变为形容词 innovative（创新的）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(innovative)：语境句：The company is famous for its innovative approach to design. 固定搭配：innovative ideas, innovative technology。原词innovate其它变形：innovation (n. 创新), innovator (n. 创新者)

questions.explanation: 考查定语从句。逗号后是非限制性定语从句，“half of + 关系代词”结构中，先行词是 French students（指人），介词 of 后应填宾格 whom。
questions.supplement: 正确形(whom)：语境句：She has three brothers, all of whom are doctors. 固定搭配：half of whom, some of whom, with whom

questions.explanation: 考查并列连词。根据语境，戏剧“不是”消费品，“而是”真正的文化交汇。符合“not... but...”(不是...而是...)的固定句型。
questions.supplement: 正确形(but)：语境句：He is not a student but a teacher. 固定搭配：not... but..., not only... but also..., nothing but

questions.explanation: 考查序数词。周年纪念日(anniversary)前面应使用序数词表示“第六十个周年”，sixty 的序数词为 sixtieth。
questions.supplement: 正确形(sixtieth)：语境句：The couple celebrated their sixtieth wedding anniversary grandly. 固定搭配：sixtieth birthday, sixtieth anniversary。原词sixty其它用法：in one's sixties (在某人六十多岁时)

questions.explanation: 考查介词。impress sb with sth 是固定搭配，意为“用某事物给某人留下深刻印象”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(with)：语境句：The candidate impressed the interviewers with his fluent spoken English. 固定搭配：impress sb with sth, leave an impression on sb。相关变形：impressed (adj.), impressive (adj.), impression (n.)

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。空处在句中作主语，且由形容词性物主代词 His 修饰，故需将动词 commit 变为名词 commitment。commitment to sth 意为“对...的投入/承诺”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(commitment)：语境句：Her commitment to environmental protection has won her widespread respect. 固定搭配：make a commitment, commitment to doing sth。原词commit其它变形：commit to doing (v. 承诺做), committed (adj. 尽心尽力的)

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give a lot of time and energy to something; to be dedicated to
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为被动语态（is devoted to），表示主语（Patrick Sommier）的状态，即“全身心投入于”。动词devote的过去分词作形容词，与be连用构成系表结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is devoted to helping underprivileged children.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她致力于帮助贫困儿童。
vocab_pack.from_passage: who is devoted to passing on the true meaning of Chinese operas

vocab_pack.definition_en: to do something that helps make something successful or better
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时（has made），主语为单数第三人称，过去分词made与has构成完成态。outstanding为形容词修饰contributions。
vocab_pack.example_en: He has made significant contributions to environmental protection.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他为环境保护做出了重大贡献。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has made outstanding contributions to Sino-French cultural exchanges

vocab_pack.definition_en: to remember something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词作时间状语，表示主语（he，即Sommier）在回忆时的主动动作。主语he与recall为主动关系，故用-ing形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: Recalling his childhood, he felt a sense of nostalgia.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 回忆起童年，他感到一阵怀旧。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Recalling his first cooperation with the Chinese theater professors in 2004

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of working together with someone to achieve a goal
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作宾语，前面有形容词性物主代词his修饰，表示“他的第一次合作”。此处cooperation为不可数名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: International cooperation is vital for solving global problems.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 国际合作对于解决全球问题至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: his first cooperation with the Chinese theater professors

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be emotionally moved or affected by something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，过去式was与touch的过去分词touched构成被动结构，表示主语（he）受到宾语（the actors' makeup...）的感动。
vocab_pack.example_en: I was touched by her sincere apology.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我被她的真诚道歉感动了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he was touched by the actors' makeup, costumes and their effort

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give something (e.g., knowledge, skills) to someone else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语to pass on作目的状语，修饰effort。pass on为及物短语动词，后接宾语the acting skills。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is important to pass on traditional customs to the younger generation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 将传统习俗传给年轻一代很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to pass on the acting skills to their students

vocab_pack.definition_en: to need something; to make something necessary
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词作后置定语，修饰art，相当于 which requires。主动关系，故用ing形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: This job requires a lot of patience and attention.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这份工作需要极大的耐心和专注。
vocab_pack.from_passage: an art requiring lifelong devotion

vocab_pack.definition_en: dedication that lasts for a whole life
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作require的宾语。lifelong为形容词修饰devotion，表示“终身的”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her lifelong devotion to music brought her worldwide fame.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她对音乐的终身奉献为她带来了世界声誉。
vocab_pack.from_passage: requiring lifelong devotion

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be determined or affected by something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语the effect为第三人称单数，故动词depend加-s。on后接名词短语the actors' inner strength and acting skills。
vocab_pack.example_en: The success of the project depends on team collaboration.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 项目的成功取决于团队合作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the effect of the performance largely depends on the actors' inner strength and acting skills

vocab_pack.definition_en: mental or spiritual power that helps someone cope with difficulties
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，与短语the actors'构成所有格，作介词on的宾语。inner为形容词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She drew on her inner strength to overcome the challenge.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她依靠内在力量克服了挑战。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the actors' inner strength and acting skills

vocab_pack.definition_en: to act according to (an instruction, suggestion, etc.)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词Following作状语，表示时间/方式，逻辑主语是句子主语Beijing Vocational College of Opera and Arts。此处为主动关系。
vocab_pack.example_en: Following the doctor's advice, he started exercising daily.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 遵循医生的建议，他开始每天锻炼。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Following Sommier's suggestion on introducing Chinese classics to the French audience

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: staged a series of appealing and innovative performances
vocab_pack.definition_en: to organize and present a performance for an audience
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式staged，表示过去发生的动作。a series of...performance是宾语，appealing and innovative为修饰语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school staged a performance of Hamlet last week.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学校上周上演了《哈姆雷特》。
vocab_pack.from_passage: BVCOA staged a series of appealing and innovative performances in 2005

vocab_pack.definition_en: attractive or interesting; pleasing
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 吸引人的；令人感兴趣的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语，与innovative并列修饰performances。
vocab_pack.example_en: The advertisement was very appealing to young consumers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这则广告对年轻消费者很有吸引力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a series of appealing and innovative performances

vocab_pack.definition_en: introducing new ideas, methods, or designs; original and creative
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语，与appealing并列修饰performances。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company is known for its innovative products.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家公司以其创新产品而闻名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: appealing and innovative performances

vocab_pack.definition_en: to attract someone to come to a place or event
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式drew，表示过去某段时间内发生的动作。主语The shows为复数，谓语用复数形式drew。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new museum drew thousands of visitors on its opening day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新博物馆在开放日吸引了数千名游客。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The shows drew over 22,000 French students

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take part in or become actively engaged in an activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式got，与过去分词involved构成被动意义上的短语（get involved表状态变化）；in后接名词短语the workshops。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many volunteers got involved in the community cleanup.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多志愿者参与了社区清洁活动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: half of whom got involved in the workshops on Chinese opera makeup and gestures

vocab_pack.definition_en: a meeting or group for intensive discussion, training, or practical work
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式workshops，作介词in的宾语。前有定冠词the修饰。
vocab_pack.example_en: The artist conducted a workshop on watercolor painting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位艺术家举办了一个水彩画工作坊。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the workshops on Chinese opera makeup and gestures

vocab_pack.definition_en: to comprehend something deeply and sincerely
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语the audience为集合名词但视为复数（或单数，此处用原形understand表示复数概念），副词truly修饰understand。
vocab_pack.example_en: Only those who have experienced hardship can truly understand its meaning.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 只有经历过苦难的人才能真正理解它的意义。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the audience truly understand that theater is not a product to consume

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: not a product to consume but a real cultural meeting
vocab_pack.definition_en: used to emphasize a contrast by denying one thing and affirming another
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 连接两个并列的名词短语（product to consume和a real cultural meeting），表示否定前者、肯定后者。此结构用于表语从句中。
vocab_pack.example_en: Success is not about luck but about hard work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 成功不在于运气，而在于努力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: theater is not a product to consume but a real cultural meeting

vocab_pack.definition_en: to buy and use goods or services; to use something up
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式to consume作后置定语，修饰名词product，相当于that we consume。此处表示“供消费的产品”。
vocab_pack.example_en: We need to consume less plastic to protect the environment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们需要减少塑料消费以保护环境。
vocab_pack.from_passage: not a product to consume but a real cultural meeting

vocab_pack.definition_en: a way of dealing with something or reaching a goal; a path toward
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 通往……的途径；对待……的方式
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词approach后接介词toward，整体作表语（an approach toward...）。toward后接what引导的宾语从句。
vocab_pack.example_en: This is a new approach toward solving the energy crisis.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这是解决能源危机的一种新途径。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a real cultural meeting and an approach toward what we wonder

vocab_pack.definition_en: to want to know something; to be curious about
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词原形，用于what引导的从句中，主语为we，故用原形。从句作介词toward的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: I wonder what life will be like in a hundred years.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我想知道一百年后的生活会是什么样子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: an approach toward what we wonder

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be a sign of an important event or turning point
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语The year 2024为第三人称单数，故动词加-s。宾语为the sixtieth anniversary。
vocab_pack.example_en: The invention of the internet marked a new era of communication.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 互联网的发明标志着交流的新时代。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The year 2024 marks the sixtieth anniversary

vocab_pack.definition_en: the yearly celebration of a past event that happened on the same date
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作宾语，前有序数词sixtieth修饰。括号内为中文注释，非原文内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: They celebrated their 50th wedding anniversary with a grand party.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们举办了一场盛大的派对庆祝金婚纪念日。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the sixtieth anniversary (周年纪念) of the establishment of diplomatic relations

vocab_pack.definition_en: the formal beginning of official relations between two countries
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词of的宾语，核心名词为establishment，后接of短语说明具体内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: The establishment of diplomatic relations between the two nations promoted trade.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 两国建交促进了贸易。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the sixtieth anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and France

vocab_pack.definition_en: to function or act in a particular role or capacity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词Serving as作状语，表示伴随或方式，逻辑主语为Sommier。serve与主语为主动关系。
vocab_pack.example_en: He served as a volunteer during the Olympic Games.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他在奥运会期间担任志愿者。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Serving as a cultural courier (信使)

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to feel admiration by showing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般将来时will impress，each other为相互代词作宾语，with引出方式或凭借物。
vocab_pack.example_en: The singer impressed the audience with her powerful voice.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位歌手用她强有力的嗓音给观众留下了深刻印象。
vocab_pack.from_passage: will impress each other with high-quality shows

vocab_pack.definition_en: a promise or dedication to do or support something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词commitment后接介词to，构成固定搭配，表示“对……的付出”。这里to为介词，后接名词短语cultural exchanges。
vocab_pack.example_en: His commitment to education earned him respect.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他对教育的奉献为他赢得了尊重。
vocab_pack.from_passage: His commitment to cultural exchanges is positive proof

vocab_pack.definition_en: clear and definite evidence that something is true
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作表语。positive为形容词修饰proof，表示“确凿的”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The DNA test was positive proof of his identity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: DNA测试是他身份的明确证据。
vocab_pack.from_passage: His commitment to cultural exchanges is positive proof of the power of arts

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause people or things to come closer and unite
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词bringing与前面的bringing people together并列，作介词in的宾语的一部分。bring...together为及物短语，people为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Music has the power to bring people together.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 音乐有将人们团结在一起的力量。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the power of arts in bringing people together

vocab_pack.definition_en: to encourage the development or growth of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词fostering与前面的bringing并列，共同作介词in的宾语，表示“在……方面的作用”。主语arts，主动关系。
vocab_pack.example_en: Good education fosters critical thinking.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 良好的教育培养批判性思维。
vocab_pack.from_passage: fostering global harmony

vocab_pack.definition_en: peace and mutual understanding among all nations worldwide
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作fostering的宾语。global为形容词修饰harmony。
vocab_pack.example_en: International cooperation is essential for achieving global harmony.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 国际合作对实现全球和谐至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: fostering global harmony
